answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objectively “best” personal-injury lawyer in Pleasanton—case value, injury type, insurance issues, and willingness to take a case to trial matter more than advertising or ratings.

For a strong Pleasanton/Tri-Valley choice, prioritize a California lawyer or firm that:

- Handles your specific type of injury case (auto collision, pedestrian, premises liability, wrongful death, etc.).
- Has actual jury-trial experience in Alameda County, not only settlement experience.
- Works on contingency—typically no attorney fee unless they recover money for you.
- Can show recent comparable results, while making clear past results do not guarantee yours.
- Has no concerning discipline history on the **State Bar of California** attorney search.
- Personally communicates with you rather than handing everything to a call center or case manager.

Good places to get vetted referrals include:

- **Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service**
- **State Bar of California** attorney search and certified-specialist directory
- Referrals from a trusted local attorney in another practice area

When you call, ask: “Have you taken cases like mine to trial in Alameda County?” “Who will actually handle my case?” “What costs come out of the settlement?” and “What is your contingency percentage if the case settles versus goes to trial?”

If you tell me what happened, the injury severity, and whether it involves a car crash, property injury, work injury, or another situation, I can help you identify what kind of Pleasanton-area lawyer is the best fit and what questions to ask.
